protocol: unified clips: center T=16, 512x512 center crop (same iterators as the ICLR evals); per-frame inference as eval_lib_v2 (STCD: clip-level 2-frame); temporal metrics from vjepa_llve/tools/temporal_metrics.py on float [0,1] outputs; GT RAFT-small flows computed once per clip and shared by all rows

methods.STCD: indoor_G.pth (all); 2-frame (t, t+1) with replicate pad at clip end; BGR in/out

notes: Use L0_SDSD-indoor (index-paired, Seer's split) for Seer comparisons; its clean6 = the 6 seqs held out for both STCD and Seer.

STCD-12_SDSD-indoor uses eval_lib.iter_sdsd_indoor_stcd, which pairs LQ/GT by basename; for pair50/52/58/60/68/70 filenames are offset and the GT is temporally misaligned (content is aligned by sorted index). Its PSNR/LPIPS/warp_err for those seqs are not meaningful; kept only for consistency with the existing *_eval_v2.json.
